title: Immersive Equipment Displays
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded. "Let's exclude this author, make a framework that includes our own simple dual sheath, and make our own display tweaks as well... We need to be ready to make our own version of everything he has. If possible, try to do a better job."
note: Skipped as a decision to BUILD the function, not to go without it. Replacement is the Ensrick Equipment Display Framework, clean-room on CommonLibSSE-NG 6.7.1, with Simple Dual Sheath folded in as a built-in slot set. Upstream is MIT, so a fork was permitted and was deliberately not taken; the clone is parked at skyrim-tools-source/_reference-ied-dev-DO-NOT-FORK for behaviour and config-schema reference only. Not installed: the equipment-display slot is currently filled by Simple Dual Sheath alone.

title: Simple Dual Sheath
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded; the feature is being built into our own framework instead of installed.
note: INSTALLED AND ENABLED at the time of the skip (SimpleDualSheath.dll 1.5.9). Stays until the Ensrick framework shows left-hand weapons and passes a launch verification, per exclusion rule 1. Shows the left-hand weapon and both staves while sheathed; needs a skeleton carrying the left-hand weapon nodes (XPMSSE 1988 is installed and enabled) and overlaps IED, so running both upstream mods means disabling features in one. Ours owns one node tree, so there is nothing to reconcile.

title: SSE Display Tweaks
author: SlavicPotato
reason: Author excluded; "we'll do our own version of SSE Display tweaks" next.
note: INSTALLED, ENABLED AND LOAD-BEARING at the time of the skip (SSE Display Tweaks Official 0.5.25). Owns borderless, the 119 fps limit, Havok fixed-step decoupling and WindowFocusGuard for the whole build (issue #149), and our own 'Ensrick - SSE Display Tweaks Configuration' overlay depends on its DLL. Does not come out until the replacement reaches parity and passes a launch verification. Prior art: Ensrick/SSEDisplayTweaks branch ensrick/1.7.99-format5 @2981fe3 located and byte-verified 26/26 patch sites in August, so the hard part is already mapped.

title: Better Third Person Selection
author: Shrimperator
reason: "Remove better third person selection", after it was identified as the source of the fade-in-fade-out 3D widget that popped up over every harvestable plant crossing the camera in third person.
revisitWhen: If third-person object selection becomes a problem on its own terms. The widget was the objection, and it is configurable (a Flora filter preset, bIsWidget3DEnabledInThirdPerson=0, or bAdjustMoreHudWidgets=0), so this is reopenable if the selection algorithm turns out to be wanted.
note: Removed 2026-09-11, transactions 20260911T202630669Z-9bea60396b27 (our 1.7.104 overlay) and 20260911T202630964Z-f238928d2a07 (BTPS 0.8.9), both recoverable in .mo2-headless-trash. The plugin held one record, the MCM quest 000D62:BetterThirdPersonSelection.esp, and nothing declared it as a master. Sunk work that leaves with it: the source-built 1.7.104 overlay with the ControlMap repair (docs/BTPS_CONTROLMAP_REPAIR_2026-09-09.md, 32768 memory-isolation cases passing) - rebuildable from records/source-builds/ensrick-btps-controlmap-1.7.104.json if it comes back. Its bAdjustMoreHudWidgets=1 was also what pinned moreHUD's text to the floating widget, so moreHUD's widgets now return to their own configured positions.

title: Darkend fog wall fix SSE port
author: deno46
reason: A patch with no base here. Darkend (10423) is not installed and has never been reviewed, so there is nothing for this fix to apply to.
revisitWhen: Darkend (10423) is adopted. Take this fix with it: the diagnosis is a real root cause, not a workaround.
note: Fixes Darkend's fog walls never letting you through. The author's diagnosis, from the mod page: the original script gates the wall on the player being out of combat, the walls open directly into boss rooms, so the boss detects the player, combat starts, Darkend's Scene is configured to end on combat, and the travel package never runs. The vanilla IsInCombat() check cannot catch it because it only tests the state before the Scene begins. Author's first SSE mod, ported from his LE version on request. v2, 175 downloads, 10 endorsements, updated 2026-09-08. Related bases also unreviewed: the Darkend Unofficial Quest Addon family (129009, 171793, 139064).

title: Open source commonlib
author: deno46
reason: Not installable content. It is a source library for plugin developers, not a mod: a preservation of CommonLibSSE-NG v4.39.3, the last MIT-licensed release, packaged so downstream plugins are not forced to GPL.
note: Evaluated as a dependency for our own plugin and declined on the merits, not ignored. v4.39.3 (24 July 2026) is a downgrade from the pinned CommonLibSSE-NG 6.7.1 and would drop the Ensrick no-modal-fail fork's log-only fatal path, so it fails both never_downgrade_rebuild_forward and no_popups_log_only_forks. It did earn its keep once: it surfaced that EnsrickEquipmentDisplay declares MIT while statically linking a GPL-3.0-or-later CommonLibSSE-NG, which is #277, and the user chose to relicense to GPL-3.0-or-later. The real artifact is the upstream GitHub tag alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG v4.39.3 (635c4168), not a Nexus page.

title: MCM super SEEDED
author: Barzing
reason: Raises a ceiling this build is nowhere near. Its headline feature is overriding SkyUI's 128-MCM limit; the build has about 10 MCM menus.
revisitWhen: The MCM count approaches 128, or the in-game rename / reorder / disable of menus becomes wanted on its own.
note: Counted 2026-09-11: 9 installed mods ship a loose SKI_ConfigBase or MCM_ConfigBase script (EVG Conditional Idles, NFF, Precision, Proteus + our hotkey overlay, Skyrim Unbound, SmoothCam, The New Gentleman, XPMSSE) plus moreHUD's inside a BSA. It is also the wrong layer for issue #276: it configures the menu LIST, not where each mod's settings live. 1293 endorsements, 113,880 downloads, so the skip is about fit, not quality.

title: AutoBody AE for SSE 1.5.97 - Configurable Randomized Bodies
author: Barzing
reason: A DLL-only overlay for a base mod we do not have, built for the wrong runtime.
revisitWhen: AutoBody AE itself is reviewed and adopted, and only then with a 1.7.104 build of the DLL.
note: The page is explicit: 'This mod only handle the DLL file, you'll have to merge it with the original AUTOBODY AE mod.' AutoBody AE is not installed, the title names 1.5.97 and we run 1.7.104, and it has not been touched since 2022-08-25. The underlying idea, randomised NPC bodies built from BodySlide presets, is a genuinely open slot given BodySlide, CBBE and HIMBO are all installed, but that is a decision about AutoBody AE, not about this overlay. 881 endorsements, 49,788 downloads.

reason: Solves a problem this build does not have, and it is an external desktop tool rather than a mod.
